verdict.rationale: Formant documents several programmatic surfaces: an Admin API for creating custom commands, query and ingestion APIs reachable through the Python Cloud SDK, an Agent SDK for telemetry, commands and teleop, and a GitHub toolkit for building apps on Formant's APIs. This gives an AI-native user a documented way to drive the product beyond the UI. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe got 404 at all candidate paths), first-party evidence of the Admin API's endpoint coverage and authentication, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
